subject: Next steps: IAM evidence & SSO/SCIM demo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: security@vastly-health.com
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's IAM discovery call

Hi team,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning — great to meet the Vastly Health security and infra leads. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- SOC 2 / compliance: You mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress, target Q1 2027. Please confirm whether the report will be available to vendors once issued.
- Regulatory needs: You indicated potential HIPAA scope for PHI-bearing workloads. We'll plan for BAAs if needed; please share any required legal contacts.
- IAM / SSO: You asked for our SAML metadata and SCIM provisioning details. I've attached our standard vendor security questionnaire and a short SCIM overview.

Attachments: vendor_security_questionnaire_redwood.pdf, redwood_scim_overview.pdf

Next steps we propose: 
1) Vastly to return the partially-completed questionnaire and your IdP metadata (SAML metadata file) — that will help our engineering team map attributes.
2) We'll provide Redwood SAML metadata and a short SCIM demo (30–45min) with our solutions engineer.
3) If HIPAA is in-scope, our legal/contracting teams will start BAA dialogue once SOW/deal terms are in play.

Can you confirm who from your side will upload the IdP metadata and who should be invited to the SCIM demo?

Thanks — I'll loop Aditya for scheduling and Olga for technical intake.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses below.

- SOC 2: We are currently undergoing SOC 2 Type II; expected audit completion 2026-12. Once finalized, we can share the report under an NDA.
- HIPAA: We anticipate some PHI will be in scope. I'll introduce our compliance counsel on the next thread.
- Questionnaire: We've started the questionnaire and attached what we've completed. See attached: vastly_filled_questionnaire.pdf.
- IdP metadata: Attached our IdP metadata (vastly_idp_metadata.xml). Our IdP is Okta; primary contact is Emily Park (emily.park@vastly-health.com).

We are interested in the SCIM demo. Suggested participants: our infra lead (cc'd Emily on the next email) and our security engineer. For timing, the week of Oct 26 works best.
